archivedSpeaking.opening: まず棟包み材の製品説明書を確認します。その後、棟に沿って取り付け、最後の一枚をシーリングします。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Give the guide's ridge-cap instruction and verify the chosen product's method.

curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve the source sequence: the crew has ridge and hip finish work left; first check the selected ridge-cap product instructions; cut caps from a starter shingle only if the product permits; install caps along the ridge; the foreman checks the ridge vent; seal the final cap and clean up. The isolated source card 10 lacks Reader 4's product condition, and the last-cap sealant method is product-specific. Archived Japanese noun/verb and roof-component senses require qualified Japanese/roofing/dictionary review. Current curriculum has no authored verb-example list; archived forms remain conditional evidence. No selected learner/audio text or progress identity is created.

cards.reviewNote: Ridge cap names a finish component, while archived 棟包み材 may name a material or assembly. Confirm the chosen product's Japanese trade term and dictionary sense.

cards.archivedJapanese: スターターシングル材
cards.reviewNote: The source starter shingle may be a distinct product from the selected ridge cap. Archived スターターシングル材 implies a material without checking the approved cap-cutting method.
Ridge is the roof line here; archived 棟 can also mean a ridge assembly. Confirm context with ridge cap and ridge vent.
Hip / limatesa is a sloping roof intersection; confirm archived 隅棟 names the intended line rather than an installed cap.
Ridge vent is a ventilation component at the ridge. Confirm archived 棟換気材 versus product/assembly term and its relationship to cap installation.
Source finish / acabado is a noun, but archived 仕上げる is a verb. Reauthor noun sense before any card selection.

cards.archivedEnglish: Cut the ridge caps from a starter shingle.
cards.reviewNote: The source card commands cutting ridge caps from a starter shingle without a product condition, while Reader 4 adds 'if the product allows it'. Hold the isolated instruction until source/product scope is resolved.

cards.sourceSpanish: Instalen los caballetes a lo largo de la cumbrera.

cards.reviewNote: Installing caps along the ridge depends on the selected ridge-cap product and ridge-vent assembly; do not select a generic construction command before product review.

cards.archivedEnglish: Check the product instructions for the ridge cap.
cards.reviewNote: The source requires checking the product instructions for the ridge cap. Confirm that archived 製品説明書 identifies the chosen product and preserves this prerequisite.

cards.reviewNote: Sealing the last cap is presented as an unconditional instruction, but the selected product's fastening/sealant method must govern; hold the directive for qualified roofing review.

reader.sourceSpanish: Corten los caballetes de una teja inicial, si el producto lo permite.

reader.reviewNote: Reader explicitly conditions cutting caps from a starter shingle on product permission; card 10 omits that condition. Hold both until source/product scope is aligned.
